newsitem.title: USA: Casino America bids for Detroit license.
newsitem.headline: Casino America bids for Detroit license.

text.p: Casino America Inc said Friday it and La Paloma LLC are bidding for a gaming license to develop a casino in Detroit.
City of Detroit Casino's chief financial officer Rex Yeisley said in an interview the City of Detroit will announce the winners of the first bidding round August 22.

The company's chances of getting the license "are as good as anybody's," Yeiley said, adding Casino would have a 25 percent equity stake in the $500 million proposed project and manage the casino. La Paloma, a group of Detroit business leaders, would have a 75 percent stake.
